title: Bound large connected external-review packages without blocking repair
goal: Fix issue #49 only where it now blocks OLQ-VALVE-PROFILE-001: when an exact candidate diff is too large for the embedded review-comment package, allow the connected primary chatgpt reviewer to receive a bounded GitHub-grounded package/state and review the immutable candidate directly from GitHub, while preserving all exact-SHA/task/authorship checks and keeping chatgpt-secondary fail-closed unless its package remains self-contained.
scope: Primary maintainer may modify only .github/workflows/external-review-request.yml plus the smallest deterministic ExternalReviewProtocol regression test needed for this behavior.

Do not modify external-review-response binding, repair-budget semantics, reviewer independence, task authorization, candidate publication, TIA workflows, product/generator code, provider policy, secrets, vendor payload handling, or IndustrialMDE.
Preserve the current <=32000-byte embedded-diff path unchanged when the candidate fits.

For reviewerSlot=chatgpt only, when the exact candidate diff exceeds the embedded-diff bound, publish a bounded WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_REVIEW package/state that still binds request ID, trusted base SHA, trusted task path/hash/id, candidate SHA, review type/round/risk class, changed-file list and deterministic Linux evidence, and explicitly requires the connected reviewer to inspect the immutable exact candidate from GitHub before responding.
The large-diff fallback must not claim that omitted source text was reviewed and must record diff byte count plus a stable SHA-256 of the full exact diff.
For chatgpt-secondary or any reviewer slot that depends on a self-contained package, retain fail-closed behavior when the package cannot include sufficient bounded source evidence.
Do not raise GitHub comment-size ceilings as the primary workaround and do not recursively embed full historical review comments.

requirements: A regression reproducing PR #77 scale (>32000-byte exact diff) reaches WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_REVIEW for reviewerSlot=chatgpt instead of failing before state publication.

The fallback package contains exact immutable identity, trusted task hash, changed files, full-diff byte count and SHA-256, deterministic Linux evidence, and an explicit instruction to inspect exact GitHub objects before verdict.
chatgpt-secondary remains fail-closed for an oversized package unless sufficient self-contained source evidence fits the existing bounds.
Response schema/state validation and CHANGES_REQUIRED -> bounded repair dispatch remain unchanged.
No candidate code executes on Windows/TIA and no product/TiaV21Worker behavior changes.
